title: bench-hpc JobSpec
description: Immutable request a benchmark site submits to an HPC gateway. Pure argv, digest-pinned runtime, path-safe inputs/outputs, bounded resources. The gateway must never re-interpret any field as shell.

operation_id.description: Optional v2 bridge: logical operation identity supplied by the v2 submit envelope. Ignored by v1 readers.

attempt.description: Optional v2 bridge: scientific attempt counter supplied by the v2 submit envelope. Ignored by v1 readers.

idempotency_key.description: Submitter-supplied unique key; re-submitting the same key must not double-schedule.

runtime.description: Image reference pinned to a content digest. Tag-only references are rejected.

command.description: argv only, no empty entries. A single shell string is rejected by construction.
